title: IAM features Burford on AI's role in patent monetization
summary: IAM features Burford Managing Director Katharine Wolanyk, who leads Burford's global patent business, in an article examining how artificial intelligence is transforming patent monetization. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*IAM* features Burford Managing Director[Katharine Wolanyk](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/) , who leads Burford's global patent business, in an article examining how artificial intelligence is transforming patent monetization. Wolanyk discusses how Burford uses AI-driven analytics to assess large patent portfolios, identify monetization opportunities and support investment decisions, while emphasizing the continued importance of human expertise in evaluating patent assets.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.iam-media.com/article/ai-patent-tools-accelerating-monetisation-human-expertise-retains-premium)
